user.title: Put the Vent-Axia unit into pairing mode
user.description: On the unit, press the Mode button once to wake the display. Press and hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. The LED will flash blue while Bluetooth pairing mode is active. Select Submit to scan for the unit.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: On the unit, press the Mode button once to wake the display. Press and hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. While the LED is flashing blue, select Submit. No PIN is required; Home Assistant will complete the MEV pairing exchange automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the unit again
reauth_confirm.description: Press Mode once to wake the display. Hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. While the LED is flashing blue, select Submit. No PIN is required.

calibrate_co2.title: Choose a CO₂ calibration method
calibrate_co2.description:
Calibration changes the accuracy of future CO₂ readings. The official Vent-Axia app accepts 400–2,000 ppm and defaults to 450 ppm. Leave 450 selected after the fresh-air preparation, or enter a reading from a trusted calibrated measurement device. A Home Assistant reference sensor should be used only when you know it is a trusted, recently calibrated, true CO₂ sensor.

Home Assistant has no safe factory/default calibration reset. To correct an earlier calibration, wait at least five minutes and run this flow again.

calibration_exposure.title: Prepare and enter the calibration value
calibration_exposure.description:
For the official 450 ppm default:
1. Open external windows and doors in every room from which the MEV extracts air.
2. Ventilate for at least 15 minutes.
3. Keep those rooms unoccupied and leave the openings open.
4. Leave the value at 450 ppm.

Alternatively, enter a current reading from a trusted calibrated measurement device. The accepted range is 400–2,000 ppm. After final confirmation, Home Assistant will display the MEV manual's three-minute sampling progress. Keep the conditions unchanged until that progress finishes; you do not need to see or reach the installed MEV/Multihome unit.

calibration_reference.title: Choose trusted CO₂ references
calibration_reference.description: Select one or more independent Home Assistant CO₂ sensors. Prefer one trusted sensor per extracted room. Home Assistant cannot determine whether a sensor is calibrated, accurate, or reports true CO₂ rather than estimated eCO₂. Keep rooms unoccupied and conditions stable until calibration finishes.

calibration_confirm.title: Confirm CO₂ calibration
calibration_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Calibration target: **internal MEV CO₂ sensor**

Reference: **{reference_ppm} ppm**

{reference_summary}

After confirmation, Home Assistant will track the documented three-minute sampling period. If the firmware completes, this new calibration supersedes the earlier baseline. Keep rooms unoccupied and conditions unchanged until its progress finishes. The physical status LED should flash magenta, but you do not need to see or reach the installed unit. An incorrect reference will make future CO₂ readings inaccurate.

data.confirm_calibration: I have completed the preparation and confirm that the reference is trustworthy

calibration_progress.title: CO₂ calibration sampling timer
calibration_progress.description: Home Assistant sent the {reference_ppm} ppm command to {device} and is tracking the MEV manual's three-minute internal-sensor sampling period. Keep every extracted room ventilated, unoccupied, and unchanged until the progress reaches 100%. At 100%, the documented sampling period has elapsed and you may close this screen with X, even if Home Assistant does not automatically advance. Closing this screen earlier does not stop a calibration command already sent.

calibration_result.title: Sampling period elapsed
calibration_result.description:
The MEV manual's three-minute sampling period has elapsed for the {reference_ppm} ppm command sent to {device}. You may now close the windows and use the rooms normally. This Home Assistant timer does not prove firmware completion because the MEV protocol exposes no calibration-status readback.

Calibration can be run again after the five-minute safety cooldown. Home Assistant has no safe calibration-reset command; repeat the prepared flow with the official 450 ppm default or a trusted measured value.

progress.calibration_sampling: At 100%, the sampling period has elapsed and this screen can be closed
